description: IAM Identity Center account assignment includes AWS AdministratorAccess managed policy
rationale: A permission set attached to a user or group is assigned to an AWS account and explicitly references the AWS-managed AdministratorAccess policy. This indicates potential administrative reach, not a proof of unrestricted effective permissions; SCPs and permissions boundaries can restrict access. Group membership and identity lookups may be incomplete.
remediation: Review the account ID, permission set ARN, principal ID/email and group membership. Confirm the business justification, least-privilege policies, permission boundaries, SCPs and time-limited access before reducing or removing the assignment.
